source_records.reason: Authors report analysis errors affecting main conclusions.

readiness_gates.requirement: Authoritative release and correction status documented
Raw bytes, generator/configuration, dataset-use terms and checksums acquired
Actual schema, labels, time semantics and alert-to-stage mapping qualified
Campaign/template groups and background grouping support leakage-resistant splits
Field availability and prefix invariance established; actual adapter tested
Nontrivial task survives type-lookup and forbidden-field controls

intake_contract.conditional_join_rule: Exclude until provenance establishes the field is observed at the decision time, not generator-only truth.
intake_contract.raw_identity_policy: Use qualified observed identities for within-stream joins only; mask direct identity memorization.
intake_contract.preprocessing: Fit transformations on training groups only; recompute context causally; do not import unqualified preprocessed columns.
intake_contract.separate_tracks: Synthetic alert-level evidence; never relabel as raw logs, packet observations, verified enterprise benign data or real APT actor attribution.

proposed_experiments.name: Missing alert robustness
proposed_experiments.type_loss: Declare qualified alert classes before fitting

proposed_experiments.name: Delayed stage progression
proposed_experiments.deadlines: Choose from training-only timeline scales and freeze before scoring

evaluation_rules.holdout: Whole campaigns/generator realizations and templates where available; never random alert rows.
evaluation_rules.thresholds: Clean calibration groups only; frozen during perturbations.
evaluation_rules.corruption: Paired, label-blind loss/delay schedules; no true corruption mask in model inputs.
evaluation_rules.denominators: Preserve original targets and missed/censored campaigns.

novelty: Unestablished; kNN alert correlation, HMM partial-observation inference, graph history and dropout are prior ideas. Withdrawn performance claims are not validated evidence.
search_scope: Primary arXiv records and historical HTML; later SSRN primary metadata; exact dataset/raw/preprocessed filename searches and publisher/repository searches. No author-controlled downloadable dataset found in checked sources; this is not proof none exists.
